correctness.rationale: Exact contact fibers over five labels: 60 ordered injective triples; for each of 3 omitted coordinate positions and each ordered pair of remaining labels, one 3-point block. Each point lies on 3 blocks, and distinct points are collinear iff exactly one coordinate changes; gives A(5,3). Each block is a maximal 3-clique and there are exactly 60 such cliques. Independently reconstructed graph has 60 vertices, 180 edges and all 60 3-cliques; S5×S3 gives 720 distinct automorphisms and exhaustive graph automorphism count in inspected source is 720. The cubic t^3+2t^2+3t+4 has no rational zero and discriminant −200, giving Galois group S3; this action permutes root-label positions, not curve holomorphic automorphisms. Degree-six canonical hyperplane section forces no extra Weierstrass incidence beyond 3 double contacts.

value.rationale: The distinguished 60 tritangents are all those with Weierstrass contacts, a canonical geometric subsystem of a highly symmetric genus-four curve. Its incidence organization into three parallel classes, intrinsic clique reconstruction, and separation of holomorphic S5 from the larger arithmetic incidence symmetry are useful invariant structural facts, not an arbitrary small-graph exercise.

scientific_limitations: Only the 60 all-Weierstrass-contact tritangents, not remaining 60 or Levi graph dualities.
Extra S3 is incidence/Galois, not asserted as projective curve automorphism.
